meaning:
1) to be soft, be delicate, be dainty
1a) (Pual) to be delicate
1b) (Hithpael)
1b1) to be of dainty habit, be pampered
1b2) to be happy about, take exquisite delight
1b3) to make merry over, make sport of

renderings.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight

elsewhere.note: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil…
For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let…
I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
